{{Quote|A hearty hello to Clegg Holdfast, and his Voltec KT9 ''Wasp''.|Fode|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''9T9-B ''Wasp''''', also known as the '''Voltec KT9 ''Wasp''''' or '''KV9T9-B''', was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] designed by [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
Produced by the typically unimaginative [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] at [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]], the 9T9-B did not defy expectations in its blandness. The first [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] produced by the company, the ''Wasp'' was competent and well-designed, if not aggressively average. Using a pair of [[KVT-Series 400 fanjet]]s, the control system for the pod was sophisticated and durable. While boasting exceptional traction and good acceleration, it didn't slow very well and it's turning and top speed were average at best. Despite its staidness, the 9T9-B was highly reliable, a rare quality in a Podracer. Easily maintained and modified, its hull was modular in design which made it a prime candidate for racers who enjoyed tinkering with the design.

==History==
A 9T9-B was piloted by [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]] during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The ''Wasp'' showed great acceleration and exceptional speed. Holdfast started the Boonta Eve Classic from the second row of the grid. He fell back almost immediately, though in the second lap, he made a surprising comeback and raced to second place. In a daring attempt at first, he tried to get past [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], but the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] torched Holdfast's engines with a hidden and highly-illegal flamethrower. Holdfast's flaming racer crashed into a rocky wall, though he survived. Fragments of Clegg's racer were later salvaged by [[Salvage droid/Legends|scavenger droids]].
